nodes.description: Constructor of SimpleERC20 that sets up name/symbol, pays fee receiver, and mints initial balance to the deployer.
ERC20 constructor initializing _name and _symbol state variables.
ServicePayer constructor which performs an external payable call to IPayable(receiver).pay.
GeneratorCopyright constructor setting the _version state variable.
Internal function that increases total supply and recipient balance, emitting a Transfer from the zero address.
Internal function moving tokens between accounts, invoking the _beforeTokenTransfer hook and updating balances.
Internal function that sets the allowance mapping and emits an Approval event.
Internal function that destroys tokens from an account and reduces total supply.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards the caller, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that checks and decrements allowance before transferring.
Public ERC20 approve that sets an allowance for a spender.
Public helper to atomically increase a spender's allowance.
Public helper to atomically decrease a spender's allowance.
Empty virtual hook called before any token transfer, mint or burn.
Returns the token balance of a given account.
Returns the remaining allowance of a spender for an owner.
Returns the current total token supply.
Context helper that returns msg.sender as the effective caller.
Returns the token name from _name.
Returns the token symbol from _symbol.
Returns the hardcoded decimals value 18.
Returns the constant generator URL _GENERATOR.
Returns the generator version from _version.
Private mapping of account balances maintained by the ERC20 contract.
Private nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Private total token supply variable.
Private token name string.
Private token symbol string.
Private generator version string.
Private constant generator URL string.
Caller address supplied by the transaction, returned by _msgSender and used for authorization.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) performed during construction.
Arithmetic update _totalSupply += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic update _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer.
Arithmetic update _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount inside _burn.
Arithmetic update _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn.
Arithmetic update _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer.
Arithmetic update currentAllowance - amount used when approving reduced allowance in transferFrom.
Arithmetic update currentAllowance - subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance.
Arithmetic update _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance.
name_ parameter of the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter of the ERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor used for the initial mint.
feeReceiver_ payable address parameter passed to ServicePayer.
receiver payable address parameter of the ServicePayer constructor used as call target.
serviceName string parameter passed to the external pay call.
version_ parameter of the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
account address parameter used by balanceOf, _mint and _burn.
recipient address parameter used by transfer, transferFrom and _transfer.
amount uint256 parameter used by transfer, transferFrom, approve, _transfer, _mint and _burn.
sender address parameter used by transferFrom and _transfer.
owner address parameter used by allowance and _approve.
spender address parameter used by allowance, approve, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
addedValue uint256 parameter used by increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue uint256 parameter used by decreaseAllowance.
Local variable caching the current allowance in transferFrom and decreaseAllowance.
Local variable caching the sender balance in _transfer.
Local variable caching the account balance in _burn.
from address parameter of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to address parameter of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.

edges.reason: SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the inherited ERC20 constructor with name_ and symbol_.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer constructor which makes an external call.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the GeneratorCopyright base constructor with version 'v5.0.1'.
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial token balance.
initialBalance_ parameter flows into _mint as the minted amount.
name_ parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor to set _name.
symbol_ parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor to set _symbol.
feeReceiver_ address flows into the ServicePayer constructor as the external call target.
ServicePayer constructor executes the external payable IPayable(receiver).pay call.
receiver parameter is the target of the external pay call.
serviceName parameter is passed as argument to the external pay call.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer resolves the caller via _msgSender for authorization.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
amount parameter flows into _transfer for balance arithmetic.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom resolves the caller via _msgSender to read its allowance.
sender parameter flows into _transfer as the debited account.
currentAllowance local flows into _approve to store the decremented allowance.
transferFrom performs the currentAllowance - amount arithmetic.
currentAllowance local is an operand of the allowance subtraction.
amount parameter is an operand of the allowance subtraction.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
approve delegates allowance setting to _approve.
approve resolves the owner via _msgSender.
spender parameter flows into _approve.
amount parameter flows into _approve as the allowance value.
increaseAllowance delegates the new allowance to _approve.
increaseAllowance performs the allowance + addedValue arithmetic.
addedValue parameter is an operand of the allowance addition.
decreaseAllowance delegates the new allowance to _approve.
decreaseAllowance performs the currentAllowance - subtractedValue arithmetic.
currentAllowance local is an operand of the decrease arithmetic.
subtractedValue parameter is an operand of the decrease arithmetic.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
